item.title: Kuwait Exempts Stranded Government Employees From Work Due To Airspace Closures
item.description: Kuwait has exempted government employees stranded abroad from work duties after regional airspace closures disrupted travel, allowing the period of absence to be counted as official working time until they are able to return to the country. item.title: Bahrain: Small Fee, Cleaner Facilities: Northern Council Backs 100 Fils Charge For Park Toilets
item.description: The Northern Municipal Council approved a proposal to introduce a symbolic 100 fils fee for using public toilets at several parks and seaside locations in the Northern Governorate. Councillors voted to raise a recommendation to the Minister of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture that the fee be implemented at three locations frequently visited by residents: Al Malkiya Coast, A’ali walking track and Abu Subh Coast. item.description: The Indian Embassy in Bahrain has issued an important advisory for Indian nationals stranded in the kingdom following the continued closure of Bahrain’s airspace since February 28. item.title: Bahrain: Knife Attack At Malkiya Beach Causes Lasting Injury
item.description: The First High Criminal Court has begun the trial of a 24-year-old Bahraini man accused of stabbing another man at Malkiya Beach, leaving the victim with a permanent disability estimated at 1%. The court adjourned the case to March 15, 2026, to bring the defendant from detention. item.title: Bahrain: Material Damage Reported After Fire At Targeted Ma’ameer Facility
item.description: Bahrain’s Civil Defence announced that a fire which broke out at a facility in the Ma’ameer area following what authorities described as a blatant Iranian attack, has been successfully brought under control. Officials confirmed that no injuries or loss of life were recorded, though the incident caused damage to the facility. Emergency teams responded quickly and secured the site.
